#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub unsafe extern "C" fn hash_str(s: *const u8) -> u64 {

        while *p != 0 {

            p = p.add(1);

#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub unsafe extern "C" fn str_reverse(s: *mut u8) {
    unsafe {
        let n = rt::strlen(s);
        let mut i = 0usize;
        while i < n / 2 {
            let t = *s.add(i);
            *s.add(i) = *s.add(n - 1 - i);
            *s.add(n - 1 - i) = t;
            i += 1;
        }
    }
}

            p = p.add(1);

// Reference translation of static_strops `str_upper`: ASCII upper-casing in place.

#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub unsafe extern "C" fn str_upper(s: *mut u8) {
    let mut p = s;
    unsafe {
        while *p != 0 {
            if *p >= b'a' && *p <= b'z' {
                *p = *p - b'a' + b'A';
            }
            p = p.add(1);
        }
    }
}

// Reference translation of static_strops `caesar`: shifts lower-case letters, returns how many.
// C `%` keeps the sign of the dividend, as Rust's does.

#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub unsafe extern "C" fn caesar(s: *mut u8, shift: i32) -> i32 {
    let mut changed: i32 = 0;
    let mut p = s;
    unsafe {
        while *p != 0 {
            if *p >= b'a' && *p <= b'z' {
                let v = (i32::from(*p) - i32::from(b'a')).wrapping_add(shift) % 26;
                *p = i32::from(b'a').wrapping_add(v) as u8;
                changed += 1;
            }
            p = p.add(1);
        }
    }
    changed
}
</kraken-rust>

// Reference translation of static_strops `join_words`: joins `n` words with `sep` into `out`
// (capacity `cap`); returns the length, or -1 when it would not fit.

#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub unsafe extern "C" fn join_words(
    out: *mut u8,
    cap: u64,
    words: *const *const u8,
    n: i32,
    sep: i8,
) -> i32 {
    let cap = cap as usize;
    let mut used: usize = 0;
    let mut i: i32 = 0;
    unsafe {
        while i < n {
            let w = *words.add(i as usize);
            let wl = rt::strlen(w);
            if used.wrapping_add(wl).wrapping_add(2) > cap {
                return -1;
            }
            rt::memcpy(out.add(used), w, wl);
            used += wl;
            if i + 1 < n {
                *out.add(used) = sep as u8;
                used += 1;
            }
            i += 1;
        }
        *out.add(used) = 0;
    }
    used as i32
}
</kraken-rust>
